messages.author: a7f0924a218fb70a
messages.subject: guide ordering difficulties
parts:
library(ggplot2)
dfa=data.frame(Year=c(2000,2000,2000,
        2001,2001,2001,
        2002,2002,2002),
        Category=c("xxx","yyy","zzz","xxx","yyy","zzz","xxx","yyy","zzz"),
        CO2eqPerCap=c(4,5,6,5,4,3,4,3,-2))

# split data frame into two based on final value in last data year.
        f=unique(dfa[dfa$Year==2002 & dfa$CO2eqPerCap>0,]$Category)
        dfp=dfa[unlist(lapply(f,grep,dfa$Category)),]
        f=unique(dfa[dfa$Year==2002 & dfa$CO2eqPerCap<0,]$Category)
        dfn=dfa[unlist(lapply(f,grep,dfa$Category)),]
        dfn=dfn[with(dfn,order(Year)),]
        dfp=dfp[with(dfp,order(Year)),]
# specify Guide legend values and colours
vals=c(
"zzz"="dodgerblue1",
"xxx"="grey55",
"yyy"="blue")
        
ggplot(aes(x=Year,y=CO2eqPerCap),data=dfa)+
                geom_area(aes(fill=Category),data=dfn)+
                geom_area(aes(fill=Category),data=dfp)+
                scale_fill_manual(values=vals)

---------------------- End of example

I have split the data frame into Categories that end negatively and those that end positively ... and have a fill layer above the
y-axis and another below. All good.

But the Guide order always seems to be xxx,yyy,zzz regardless of the values I specify in the scale.

What am I missing here ... ?

Cheers,
Geoff Russell

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: guide ordering difficulties
parts:
The order is controlled by the levels of the variable. If I understand
your question (you didn't explicitly ask a clear question so I'm not
entirely sure) you are looking for

ggplot(aes(x=Year,y=CO2eqPerCap),
data=transform(dfa, Category = factor(Category, levels =
c("zzz", "xxx", "yyy"))))+
geom_area(aes(fill=Category))+
geom_area(aes(fill=Category))+
scale_fill_manual(values=vals)

Best,
Ista

messages.subject: Re: guide ordering difficulties
parts:
One other important detail -- when using different data in different
layers you may need to set drop=FALSE in the scale call to preserver
the order. That is, you can set the order of Category in dfa and dfn
using factor as in my example above, and then use

scale_fill_manual(values=vals, drop = FALSE)

Best,
Ista

messages.author: a7f0924a218fb70a
messages.subject: Re: guide ordering difficulties
parts:
Posting again ... if you are still watching Ista ... please try the code below ... p1 doesn't give yyy, xxx, zzz as the
legend, but p2 does ...

It seems to be the "breaks" that is the critical argument ...

& from the help pages: "breaks ... • a character vector giving the breaks as they should
              appear on the axis or in the legend."

library(ggplot2)
dfa=data.frame(Year=c(2000,2000,2000,
        2001,2001,2001,
        2002,2002,2002),
        Category=c("xxx","yyy","zzz","xxx","yyy","zzz","xxx","yyy","zzz"),
        CO2eqPerCap=c(4,5,6,5,4,3,4,3,-2))

f=unique(dfa[dfa$Year==2002 & dfa$CO2eqPerCap>0,]$Category)
        dfp=dfa[unlist(lapply(f,grep,dfa$Category)),]
        f=unique(dfa[dfa$Year==2002 & dfa$CO2eqPerCap<0,]$Category)
        dfn=dfa[unlist(lapply(f,grep,dfa$Category)),]
        dfn=dfn[with(dfn,order(Year)),]
        dfp=dfp[with(dfp,order(Year)),]

vals=c(
"zzz"="dodgerblue1",
"xxx"="grey55",
"yyy"="blue")

p1=ggplot(aes(x=Year,y=CO2eqPerCap),
                data=transform(dfa,Category=factor(Category,levels=c("yyy","xxx","zzz"))))+
                geom_area(aes(fill=Category),data=dfn)+
                geom_area(aes(fill=Category),data=dfp)+
                scale_fill_manual(values=vals)
        p2=ggplot(aes(x=Year,y=CO2eqPerCap),
                data=dfa)+
                geom_area(aes(fill=Category),data=dfn)+
                geom_area(aes(fill=Category),data=dfp)+
                scale_fill_manual(values=vals,breaks=c("yyy","xxx","zzz"))

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: guide ordering difficulties
parts:
Hi Geoff,

Yes, you can set the breaks. Alternatively if you start with

dfa=data.frame(Year=c(2000,2000,2000,
2001,2001,2001,
2002,2002,2002),
Category=factor(c("xxx","yyy","zzz","xxx","yyy","zzz","xxx","yyy","zzz"),
levels = c("zzz", "xxx", "yyy")),
CO2eqPerCap=c(4,5,6,5,4,3,4,3,-2))

then

ggplot(aes(x=Year,y=CO2eqPerCap), data = dfa)+
geom_area(aes(fill=Category),data=dfn)+
geom_area(aes(fill=Category),data=dfp)+
scale_fill_manual(values=vals, drop = FALSE)

will also give the correct order.

Best,
Ista
